messages.content: A teammate asked how snackWikiSearch.jsp should reread keyword, category, and page.
On this cookies snack-wiki search page, what should the query bag be called, and which helper must read keyword, category, and page? Do not use the browser URL parser.

On snackWikiSearch.jsp, the locked internal name of the query bag is CkQBag. Scripts must read keyword, category, and page only through ckParseQBag; URLSearchParams and new URL(location.href).searchParams.get are forbidden on this page. Public copy may still say search query.
On this cookies snack-wiki search page, what should the query bag be called, and which helper must read keyword, category, and page? Do not use the browser URL parser.
Allergy td cells on this cookies snack-wiki modal need to become checkboxes.
On this cookies snack-wiki allergy table, what value prefix must each converted checkbox use instead of the raw td id?
Allergy td-to-checkbox conversion must set value to `CkCellSeal:<original-td-id>` (exact prefix, colon, original id). Do not use the raw td id as the checkbox value.
On this cookies snack-wiki allergy table, what value prefix must each converted checkbox use instead of the raw td id?
The search controller already returns the snack-wiki result view and supplies the result collection.

In SnackController.snackSearch, keep the existing result-list model attribute and returned JSP view name unchanged while adding a null guard around the optional category filter. Show the smallest controller-only edit.
The allergy modal already renders an icon and Hangul text for every option.
In snackWikiSearch.jsp, add a title attribute to the milk allergy icon using the visible Hangul label already beside it. Edit that one image element only.
The allergy modal already renders an icon and Hangul text for every option.
In snackWikiSearch.jsp, add loading="lazy" to the milk allergy icon without changing the surrounding input or label markup. Edit that one image element only.
The snack-wiki result page already has a visible heading above the allergy choices.
In snackWikiSearch.jsp, add aria-live="polite" to the existing search-result count container. Do not change the allergy controls or request parameters.
The allergy modal shows an image plus Hangul name per option.
In snackWikiSearch.jsp, add decoding="async" to the egg allergy icon. Do not change its surrounding control markup or edit other files.
The result cards already print snack names and calorie values from the server model.
In snackWikiSearch.jsp, append the literal text " kcal" after each rendered calorie value. Keep the model expression and all search handlers unchanged.
The result page already exposes a category select and a search submit button.

In snackWikiSearch.jsp, disable the search submit button only while its existing form submission is in progress, then restore it if client-side submission is cancelled. Do not change field names or parsing.
The allergy modal is a table and its option icons already have CSS classes.
In snackWikiSearch.jsp, add width and height attributes to the egg allergy icon using its currently rendered dimensions. Leave the table controls and submitted values untouched.
SnackController.snackSearch already validates the keyword before running the service query.
In SnackController.snackSearch, trim the incoming keyword before the existing blank-keyword validation and pass the trimmed value onward. Do not change any allergy binding behavior.
The allergy modal opens from an existing button and closes through its current control.
In snackWikiSearch.jsp, add aria-expanded to the existing allergy-modal trigger and update it on open and close. Do not alter the option controls inside the modal.
The allergy modal shows icons next to Hangul names.
In snackWikiSearch.jsp, add an alt attribute to the egg allergy icon using the visible Hangul text already shown beside it. Do not edit other files.
The search page already displays Hangul text correctly once the response reaches the browser.
In snackWikiSearch.jsp, add lang="ko" to the root html element and leave request filters, form fields, and controller code unchanged.
The search page title is shown in the browser tab and does not affect request decoding.
In snackWikiSearch.jsp, change only the document title to include the existing Korean snack-wiki name followed by " - Search". Do not edit web.xml or controller code.
